description: Asks for a deposit or first month's rent before you have viewed the property in person
example_phrases: send the deposit to secure it
pay the deposit and I will arrange the viewing
transfer the deposit today to hold the room

description: Landlord claims to be abroad or out of the country and cannot show the property
example_phrases: I am out of the country

description: No in-person viewing is possible, or there is always an excuse to avoid one
example_phrases: you can't view it at the moment
I can send you a video instead

description: Offers to send keys or a contract by post or courier after payment, instead of handing them over at a viewing. Official advice is to check the keys work before paying; scammers may send fake keys or false contracts
example_phrases: the keys will be sent by courier
an agent will deliver the keys after payment
I will email you the contract
note: Sources warn about fake keys / keys that don't work and say to test keys before paying. The exact 'keys by post' wording is not in the official text (not verified as an official phrase).

description: Asks for payment by cash, cryptocurrency, gift cards, money transfer services (e.g. Western Union) or peer-to-peer transfer apps
example_phrases: send it to my PayPal friends and family

description: The account you are asked to pay into is in a different country
example_phrases: pay into my account in Spain
my bank account is in the UK
note: A non-IE IBAN country code can also be checked by a rule.

description: Pressure to pay quickly, e.g. a 'one-time offer' or threats that you will lose the property if you delay
example_phrases: pay today or it goes to the next person
I need an answer within the hour

description: Rent is far below the RTB average for the area (too good to be true)
example_phrases: great price for a quick tenant
note: Detected by a rule using data/rents.json, not by the LLM. Garda advice says to compare the asking price with the RTB rent index.

description: Contact only through WhatsApp, Messenger, text, email or social media; no phone call or meeting
example_phrases: I can only reply by email

description: Listing text or photos copied from other adverts; the same bogus property advertised in multiple places
example_phrases: photos look like a hotel or another country
same description seen on another advert
note: Best detected by matching against the shared report list (hash of normalised text), not only by the LLM.

description: Asks for copies of your passport, bank statements or other sensitive documents before the landlord and property are confirmed genuine
example_phrases: send a copy of your passport
I need your ID before the viewing
send a photo of your ID with the payment receipt

description: Asks for a deposit and rent before any lease or written agreement, often 'no questions asked'
example_phrases: we can sign the contract after you pay
